findings.title: Dancers cannot apply follow-up voice edits — both changed edit attempts still request the nonexistent Claude model and return the original kit
findings.observed: Both model attempts fail; edit returns applied:false and the card stays unchanged

findings.title: Dancers lose personalized AI shot plans — both changed build attempts still request the nonexistent Claude model before falling back
findings.observed: Both model attempts fail and generation falls back to the catalog template

findings.title: Dancers lose a named song when the model fails — the changed fallback recognizes only titles already in the trend list
findings.observed: A named non-trending song becomes 'Your trending track'

findings.title: Dancers can still order a different kit than selected — the changed card passes the live kit to an open checkout while a build or edit can finish
findings.observed: A replacement kit changes the displayed checkout price and submitted kit_id

findings.title: Dancers can still receive unshareable and unorderable kits — the changed build returns an ID even when saving fails
findings.observed: An insert failure returns 200 with an id that GET and checkout cannot find

findings.title: Dancers still get too few group wands in a budgeted fallback kit — the changed fitter discards crew quantities before replacing costlier cues
findings.observed: For 5 dancers at $17, the fitter reduces 5 wands to 3 although five can fit

findings.title: Dancers can remain recorded after releasing the mic — a second press while permission is pending lets both streams start but tracks only the last recorder
findings.observed: Two pending permission requests can start two recorders while only one is stopped

findings.title: Dancers' microphones can stay active after an unsupported recording attempt — the mic error path catches failure without closing the acquired stream
findings.observed: If MediaRecorder construction or start throws, the acquired mic tracks are not stopped

findings.title: Dancers get no live You.com trends in the supplied configuration — the backend environment still lacks the requested API key
findings.observed: YDC_API_KEY is absent, so the search returns house picks without calling You.com

findings.title: Dancers can get removed fireworks back after a voice edit — the changed planner pads and budget-swaps without excluding removed items
findings.observed: Removing confetti can add item 6 again while padding or fitting the four cues

findings.title: Customers can send a new kit to an earlier kit's location — the order dialog retains old spot and time when the new kit has no delivery
findings.observed: Opening a new kit keeps the previous order's spot and time selected

findings.title: Dancers can miss their requested group wands in the fallback kit — the changed fallback omits the wand when four other effects fill its cue slots
findings.observed: A five-person request with four other effect types can produce no wand cart line

findings.title: Dancers can still lose their chosen drop firework — the changed budget planner replaces the protected drop with a cheaper item
findings.observed: A tight budget swaps the selected drop item to another catalog item

findings.title: Dancers can still receive their largest firework away from the beat drop — the changed planner keeps a cheaper existing drop cue without comparing other cues
findings.observed: An expensive non-drop cue can remain bigger than the chosen drop cue

findings.title: Dancers can still be told the wrong effect for a catalog item — the changed builder retains unchecked model effect text
findings.observed: A cue can display a model effect inconsistent with its item's catalog type

findings.title: Dancers can still receive plans missing model-proposed cues — the changed builder silently discards invalid entries instead of retrying
findings.observed: A response with one valid cue and invalid others is padded and accepted

findings.title: Dancers still get a fallback drop at the wrong second — the changed fallback uses a parser that clamps 15 seconds to 14
findings.observed: A requested drop at 15s becomes 14s in a fallback kit

findings.title: Dancers on tall narrow phones still see a stretched preview — the changed phone frame clamps width independently of height
findings.observed: max-w-full can narrow a fixed-height 9:16 phone frame

findings.title: Dancers still see DROP stuck on the final frame for late drops — the changed label expires against a clock capped at 15 seconds
findings.observed: A drop at 14s keeps DROP visible after the preview ends

findings.title: Keyboard users can still activate hidden kit controls behind the preview — the changed overlay has no focus management or dialog semantics
findings.observed: Tab can move focus to the underlying page while the fullscreen preview is open

findings.title: Dancers still cannot pause the preview to inspect a cue — the changed timeline continues without a pause state or control
findings.observed: The timeline advances to 0:15 with only Replay available

findings.title: Dancers can still see a mixed preview when the kit changes — the changed card passes a new kit to a director holding the old fired-cue state
findings.observed: A build or edit can replace cues without resetting the running preview

findings.title: Phone users can still lose long song names or filming instructions — the changed card clips unbreakable text
findings.observed: A long unbroken song or instruction is clipped by the overflow-hidden card

findings.title: Dancers can still fire fractional cues at the wrong moment — the changed card rounds seconds and groups nearby drop cues
findings.observed: A fractional drop is displayed as a rounded whole second

findings.title: Keyboard users still cannot record a voice request or edit — the changed mic handles only pointer events
findings.observed: Keyboard activation never calls the recording start or stop handlers

findings.title: Dancers who cannot record may leave a recording compositor running — the new failure handler does not cancel its animation loop or stop its stream
findings.observed: A MediaRecorder setup failure releases controls but leaves paint() scheduled

findings.title: Dancers can receive a broken or incomplete recording as a successful download — recorder errors are followed by an unconditional onstop save and success toast
findings.observed: A recorder error calls fail(), then onstop downloads data and shows 'Clip saved'

findings.title: Dancers can lose their explicitly requested firework in a budgeted fallback — the fitter swaps requested effects before choosing a cheaper unrequested drop
findings.observed: A 'smoke, $10 budget' fallback can replace its only smoke cue with confetti

findings.title: Khmer readers see English firework labels in a new Khmer kit — the localized fallback still writes catalog effect and item names in English
findings.observed: A newly built Khmer fallback shows English effect names such as 'confetti'

findings.title: Dancers can receive fireworks they expressly excluded in fallback kits — keyword matching treats negated effect names as requested items
findings.observed: A request saying 'no smoke' is treated as a request for a smoke item

findings.title: Dancers can still receive an over-budget kit after a riel voice edit — the changed editor trusts a positive model budget over its currency parser
findings.observed: A positive model budget overrides the server-parsed riel amount

findings.title: Dancers cannot lower a voice-edited budget to zero — the editor treats parsed zero as absent and restores the previous budget
findings.observed: A voice edit setting a $0 budget keeps the previous positive budget

findings.title: Dancers can have part of a previous delivery silently changed by an invalid voice command — the new merge applies valid fields even when the other field is invalid
findings.observed: An invalid spot paired with 21:00 can still overwrite the previous delivery time

findings.title: Dancers can lose a stored delivery on a later unrelated edit — the new merge trusts model delivery fields without checking the voice command and omits the current delivery from its snapshot
findings.observed: An unrelated edit can replace delivery if the model returns a different valid spot

findings.title: Dancers can still have a voice edit overwrite a new build — the changed Build guard starts only after transcription returns
findings.observed: Build remains enabled while a follow-up recording is transcribing

findings.title: Dancers can still have unrecognized voice commands silently rewrite their kit — the changed editor applies model output without checking the requested change
findings.observed: Any parseable model response can be stored as applied even when it ignores the command

findings.title: Dancers can still leave orphaned kit revisions after a failed edit — the changed endpoint inserts the kit before validating the changes field
findings.observed: An invalid changes value can leave inserted revisions even when applied is false

findings.title: Dancers can still mistake an old kit for a failed new request — the changed build handler retains the previous card without marking it stale
findings.observed: A failed new build leaves the old kit displayed without a stale label

findings.title: Dancers still cannot see exactly what a voice edit removed or changed — the changed card highlights only surviving cart rows and newly keyed cues
findings.observed: Removed cart lines and delivery changes have no corresponding highlighted row

findings.title: Dancers can lose an undo while the next voice command transcribes — the new undo stays enabled until the edit request starts and the transcript retains the old kit
findings.observed: Undo can be overwritten by an edit transcript that completes afterwards

findings.title: Dancers can receive a different size or bundle than the catalog item they requested — the new fallback maps generic keywords to fixed IDs and has no Crew Pack match
findings.observed: A 'Gold Fountain Small' request selects Gold Fountain Tall in the fallback

findings.title: Dancers can lose a spoken delivery time even though the edit reports success — the changed delivery cleaner rejects natural 12-hour times rather than normalizing them
findings.observed: A model time of '9pm' is discarded instead of being normalized to 21:00

findings.title: Dancers' clips do not reproduce all phone-view chrome — the new overlay omits the Share caption and does not constrain text to the onscreen text area
findings.observed: Recorded clips omit the visible 'Share' caption and draw unbounded kit/song text

findings.title: Khmer readers still receive an English shared-link error — the changed App hardcodes the English dictionary in its load failure handler
findings.observed: A failed shared-kit lookup always shows the English kitLoadFail string
